name: Little Richard
hook: A singer and pianist from Macon, Georgia, whose screamed, pounding records the Beatles and the Kinks learned from, and who spent decades suing for the royalties.

blurb.age13: Little Richard was born Richard Penniman in Macon, Georgia, in 1932. In September 1955 in New Orleans he recorded 'Tutti Frutti', after a songwriter cleaned up his rude lyrics. His records were loud and wild: pounding piano, screaming, saxophone. In 1957 he quit rock and roll to study religion. When he came back, the Beatles opened for him in 1962 and he showed Paul McCartney how he sang. Both the Beatles and the Kinks recorded his 'Long Tall Sally'.
blurb.adult: Born in Macon in 1932. 'Tutti Frutti' was recorded at Cosimo Matassa's J&M Studio in New Orleans in September 1955 for Specialty Records, with Dorothy LaBostrie rewriting its sexual lyrics; 'Long Tall Sally' (1956) reached number one on the R&B chart. He left for theology study in 1957. In 1962 Brian Epstein booked the Beatles to open for him in New Brighton and at Hamburg's Star-Club, and Little Richard coached McCartney in the high, screamed delivery McCartney used on the Beatles' rock and roll covers. In 1984 he sued Specialty and its owner Art Rupe for $112 million in unpaid royalties since 1959; the case settled in 1986. He died in 2020.
